game_title: Code Reading Relay – Cactus Flats Trial
game_concept: A puzzle set in Sand Dunes – Cactus Flats, flats of tall cacti: the sand ranger must handle dust devils while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Code Reading Relay: Read short programs as a relay and predict their output line by line.
theme: Sand Dunes – Cactus Flats: flats of tall cacti
core_gameplay_loop: In Cactus Flats, repeat each round: Read short programs as a relay and predict their output line by line. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the predicted value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the bazaar gate using at most 18 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: The bazaar gate reached with actions_used <= 18.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 18 before the bazaar gate is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 1 (intro tier): Code Reading Relay
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
